margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></p> <hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/> <div style="text-align:center"> <div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement.</p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On April&#160;1, 2026 (the &#8220;Distribution Date&#8221;), Aptiv PLC (&#8220;Aptiv&#8221;) completed the previously announced distribution of all of the ordinary shares of Versigent Limited (&#8220;Versigent,&#8221; the &#8220;Company,&#8221; &#8220;we,&#8221; &#8220;us,&#8221; or &#8220;our&#8221;) to holders of Aptiv&#8217;s ordinary shares on a pro rata basis (the <span style="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;Spin-Off&#8221;).</span> Each holder of record of Aptiv ordinary shares received one of our ordinary shares for every three Aptiv ordinary shares held on March&#160;17, 2026 (the &#8220;Record Date&#8221;).</p><p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Prior to the Distribution Date, in connection with the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off,</span> the Company entered into several agreements with Aptiv that set forth the principal actions taken or to be taken in connection with the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off</span> and that govern the relationship between us and Aptiv following the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off,</span> including the following agreements (collectively, the &#8220;Spin Agreements&#8221;):</p><p style="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>

<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><p style=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt;text-align:left">an Employee Matters Agreement.</p></td></tr></table><p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">A summary of certain material terms of each of the Spin Agreements can be found in the section entitled &#8220;Certain Relationships and Related Person Transactions&#8212;Agreements with Aptiv&#8221; in the Information Statement attached as Exhibit 99.1 to Versigent&#8217;s Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K</span> filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (&#8220;SEC&#8221;) on March&#160;12, 2026 (the &#8220;Information Statement&#8221;), and is incorporated herein by reference. The summary is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Separation and Distribution Agreement, the Transition Services Agreement, the Tax Matters Agreement and the Employee Matters Agreement, which are filed as Exhibits 2.1, 10.1, 10.2 and 10.3, respectively, to this Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K,</span> and are incorporated herein by reference.</p><p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;2.01 Completion of Acquisition or Disposition of Assets.</p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On the Distribution Date, Aptiv completed the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off.</span> The description of <span style="white-space:nowrap">the&#160;Spin-Off&#160;and</span> Distribution included in Item 1.01 is incorporated herein by reference into this Item 2.01. In connection with and prior to <span style="white-space:nowrap">the&#160;Spin-Off&#160;and</span> Distribution, Aptiv transferred its Electrical Distribution Systems segment to the Company. The Company&#8217;s combined audited financial statements included in the Information Statement are incorporated by reference herein.</p><p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;2.03 Creation of a Direct Financial Obligation or an Obligation under an <span style="white-space:nowrap">Off-Balance</span> Sheet Arrangement of a Registrant.</p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">As previously announced, on November&#160;26, 2025, the Company and its wholly-owned subsidiaries Cyprium Corporation (&#8220;Cyprium U.S.&#8221;) and Cyprium Holdings Luxembourg S.&#192;.R.L. (&#8220;Cyprium Luxembourg&#8221;), entered into a credit agreement (the &#8220;Initial Credit Agreement&#8221;), which was subsequently amended on March&#160;25, 2026, pursuant to an amendment (the &#8220;Amendment&#8221; the Initial Credit Agreement, as amended by the Amendment, the &#8220;Credit Agreement&#8221;) with the lenders party thereto, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent (the &#8220;Administrative Agent&#8221;) and domestic collateral agent (the &#8220;Domestic Collateral Agent&#8221;) and Wilmington Trust, National Association, as foreign collateral agent (the &#8220;Foreign Collateral Agent&#8221;), with respect to $1.35&#160;billion in senior secured credit facilities. The Credit Agreement consists of a senior secured five-year $500&#160;million term loan facility (the &#8220;Term Loan A Facility&#8221;) and a five-year $850&#160;million senior secured revolving credit facility (the &#8220;Revolving Credit Facility&#8221;) (collectively, the &#8220;Credit Facilities&#8221;). In connection with the completion of <span style="white-space:nowrap">the&#160;Spin-Off,&#160;the</span> Term Loan A Facility was fully drawn on March&#160;27, 2026.</p><p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The foregoing description is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Credit Agreement, attached as Exhibit 10.4 to the Company&#8217;s Registration Statement on Form 10, initially filed with the SEC on November&#160;14, 2025, as amended, and declared effective on March&#160;12, 2026.</p><p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">As previously announced, on March&#160;18, 2026, Cyprium U.S. and Cyprium Luxembourg (the <span style="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;Co-Issuers&#8221;)</span> issued $800&#160;million aggregate principal amount of 6.125% senior unsecured notes due 2031 (the &#8220;2031 Notes&#8221;) and $800&#160;million aggregate principal amount of 6.375% senior unsecured notes due 2034 (the &#8220;2034 Notes&#8221; and, together with the 2031 Notes, the &#8220;Senior Notes&#8221;), pursuant to an Indenture, dated March&#160;18, 2026 (the &#8220;Indenture&#8221;), between the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Co-Issuers</span> and U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as trustee (the &#8220;Trustee&#8221;). Interest on the Senior Notes is payable semi-annually on April&#160;15 and October&#160;15 of each year. The proceeds received from the Senior Notes offering were deposited into escrow. In connection with the completion of <span style="white-space:nowrap">the&#160;Spin-Off,</span> on March&#160;30, 2026, certain of the Company&#8217;s subsidiaries that guarantee the Credit Facilities (the &#8220;Guarantors&#8221;) and the Trustee entered into a supplemental indenture (the &#8220;Supplemental Indenture&#8221;), which amended and supplemented the Indenture to add the Guarantors as guarantors of the Senior Notes, and the proceeds were released from escrow. The <span style="white-space:nowrap">Co-Issuers</span> used proceeds of the offering, together with proceeds from borrowings under the Credit Facilities, to pay a dividend to Aptiv in connection with the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off.</span></p><p style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;text-align:center">1</p></div></div><p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></p> <hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/> <div style="text-align:center"> <div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The foregoing description is qualified in its entirety by reference to the Indenture, which is filed as Exhibit 4.1 to this Current Report on <span style="white-space:nowrap">Form&#160;8-K,</span> and the Supplemental Indenture, which is filed as Exhibit 4.2 to this Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K,</span> and are each incorporated herein by reference.</p><p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;3.02. Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities.</p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On March&#160;26, 2026, in connection with <span style="white-space:nowrap">the&#160;Spin-Off,&#160;the</span> Company issued 70,892,660 ordinary shares to Aptiv in consideration for the transfer of certain entities that are part of Aptiv&#8217;s Electrical Distribution Systems segment. After this issuance, Aptiv held 70,893,660 ordinary shares of the Company. The ordinary shares issued to Aptiv were issued in reliance upon an exemption from registration pursuant to Section&#160;4(a)(2) under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, which exempts transactions by an issuer not involving any public offering. The offering was not a &#8220;public offering&#8221; because only one person was involved in the transaction, neither the Company nor Aptiv has engaged in general solicitation or advertising with regard to the issuance and sale of the ordinary shares, and neither the Company nor Aptiv has offered securities to the public in connection with such issuance and sale of the ordinary shares.</p><p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;3.03. Material Modification to Rights of Security Holders.</p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The information set forth under Item 5.03 below is incorporated into this Item 3.03 by reference.</p><p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;5.01. Changes in Control of Registrant.</p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The information set forth under Item 1.01 above is incorporated into this Item 5.01 by reference.</p><p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers.</p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">Resignation of Directors </span></p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On April&#160;1, 2026, effective upon the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off,</span> Katherine H. Ramundo and Timothy C. Seitz (collectively, the &#8220;Resigning Directors&#8221;) resigned from the Board of Directors (the &#8220;Board&#8221;) of the Company. The Resigning Directors&#8217; resignation from the Board was not due to any disagreement with the Company relating to the operations, practices or policies of the Company.</p><p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">Appointment of Directors </span></p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On March&#160;30, 2026, the Board appointed each of Mr.&#160;Joseph&#160;T. Liotine, Ms.&#160;Amy Alving, Mr.&#160;Brad Cerepak, Mr.&#160;Armando Tamez, Mr.&#160;Eric&#160;Kueppers and Mr.&#160;Kevin Clark as a director of the Board, increasing the size of the Board from three to seven directors, in each case effective immediately prior to the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off.</span> Mr.&#160;Paul Meister, who had been elected to the Board effective March&#160;27, 2026, will continue to serve as a director of the Company following the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off</span> and on March&#160;30, 2026, was appointed as <span style="white-space:nowrap">non-executive</span> Chair of the Board, effective immediately prior to the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off.</span></p><p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Also, effective immediately prior to the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off,</span> the persons set forth below assumed positions as members of the Audit Committee of the Board, the Compensation and Human Resources Committee of the Board, and the Nominating and Governance Committee of the Board, in each case as mentioned next to such person&#8217;s name.</p><p style="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>

under the rules and regulations of the SEC and the applicable listing standards of the NYSE as well as the heightened independence standards for Audit Committee members set forth in the rules and regulations of the SEC and applicable listing standards of the NYSE, and (iii)&#160;each of Ms.&#160;Alving, Mr.&#160;Kueppers and Mr.&#160;Meister satisfy the heightened independence standards for Compensation Committee members set forth in the rules and regulations of the SEC and the applicable listing standards of the NYSE.</p><p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic"><span style="white-space:nowrap">Non-Employee</span> Director Compensation </span></p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Each of the <span style="white-space:nowrap">non-employee</span> directors will participate in the Company&#8217;s director compensation program, pursuant to which each such director is expected to receive annual compensation in the amount of $300,000 for his or her services as a <span style="white-space:nowrap">non-employee</span> director, which will be paid 60% in <span style="white-space:nowrap">time-based</span> restricted stock units (&#8220;RSUs&#8221;) and the remainder in cash. Mr.&#160;Meister will be entitled to receive an additional annual cash retainer of $185,000 for his service as <span style="white-space:nowrap">non-executive</span> Chair of the Board. Chairs of the following committees will be entitled to the following applicable additional annual cash retainers: (a)&#160;Audit Committee Chair: $30,000; (b) Compensation and Human Resources Committee Chair: $25,000; and (c)&#160;Nominating and Governance Committee Chair: $20,000. Each <span style="white-space:nowrap">non-employee</span> director may elect, on an annual basis, to receive 80% or 100% of his or her annual compensation in RSUs, with the remainder to be paid in cash. Cash amounts will be payable quarterly in arrears and will be prorated for partial years of service. RSU grants will be made on the day of the Company&#8217;s annual shareholder meeting and will generally vest on the day before the next annual meeting (other than during the calendar year in which the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off</span> occurs, in which case, RSU grants will be made following the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off).</span> Each <span style="white-space:nowrap">non-employee</span> director will be required to hold $600,000 in the Company&#8217;s ordinary shares and has up to five years from his date of appointment to fulfill this holding requirement.</p><p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold"><span style="font-style:italic">Appointment of Officers </span></p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On April&#160;1, 2026, effective as of the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off,</span> the Board appointed the following individuals to the offices of the Company indicated opposite their names:</p><p style="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>

<td style="white-space:nowrap;vertical-align:bottom">&#160;</td></tr></table><p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">After the&#160;Spin-Off,&#160;the executive compensation programs, policies, and practices for our executive officers will be subject to the review and approval of the Compensation and Human Resources Committee described above.</p><p style="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&#160;</p><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;text-align:center">4</p></div></div><p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"></p> <hr style="color:#999999;height:3px;width:100%;clear:both"/> <div style="text-align:center"> <div style="width:8.5in;text-align:left;margin-left: auto;margin-right: auto"><p style="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;5.03. Amendments to Articles of Incorporation or Bylaws; Change in Fiscal Year.</p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Upon the effectiveness of the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off,</span> the Company converted from a limited company to a public limited company under the laws of Jersey and changed its name from &#8220;Versigent Limited&#8221; to &#8220;Versigent PLC.&#8221; The Company&#8217;s Memorandum and Articles of Association became effective in connection with the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off</span> and were approved, on March&#160;26, 2026, by Aptiv, in its capacity as the sole member of the Company.</p><p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">A summary of the material provisions of the Memorandum and Articles of Association can be found in the section entitled &#8220;Description of Share Capital&#8221; in the Information Statement. This summary does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Memorandum and Articles of Association, which are filed as Exhibit 3.1 to this Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K</span> and incorporated herein by reference.</p><p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;8.01 Other Events.</p><p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On April&#160;1, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing the completion of the <span style="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off.</span> The full text of the press release is filed as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K</span> and is incorporated by reference in this Item 8.01.</p><p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;9.01.
